svg.text: ENTERPRISE SUPPLY CHAIN FORECASTING: CHRONOS/TIMESFM + LIGHTGBM & SAFETY-STOCK
LightGBM + Chronos/TimesFM + LLM Covariate Extractor Hits 9.4% WAPE & 1.1% Stockout
500K SKU-Store Pairs: Tier 1 Text-LLM CSV Forecast (28.4% WAPE, $640K/mo) vs. Tier 2 ARIMA vs. Tier 4 ($68K/mo)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: Text-LLM Numbers & Point-Forecast Risk
1. Prompting Text LLMs with Sales CSVs (28.4% WAPE, $85K/mo Tokens):
• BPE tokenizers split numbers arbitrarily; text LLMs hallucinate
seasonality, miss cannibalization & burn $85K/mo across 500K SKUs
2. Classical Univariate ARIMA / ETS (39.0% Cold-Start SKU WAPE):
• Blind to new product launches (<8 wks history) & unstructured
marketing campaign PDFs or port-strike delay notices
3. Point-Forecast LightGBM Without P95 Quantiles (4.8% Stockouts):
• Single-point mean forecasts ignore supplier lead-time tail risk
Production Failure Impact (500K SKU-Store Pairs Weekly):
• Forecast Error (WAPE): 28.4% (Tier 1) | Cold-Start: 42.0%
• Shelf Stockout Rate: 9.2% (Lost high-margin sales & penalties)
• Monthly Stockout, Excess Inventory & Token TCO: $640,000 / mo
🏆 Tier 4: LightGBM + Chronos TSFM + P95 Conformal
1. LLM Unstructured Covariate Featurizer ($120/mo vs $85K/mo):
• Uses LLM ONLY to parse promo PDFs & supplier port alerts into
numerical features (`promo_depth`, `lead_time_delta_days`)
2. LightGBM (Dense SKUs) + Chronos-Bolt / TimesFM (Cold-Start SKUs):
• Pre-trained time-series patch foundation model cuts cold-start
SKU WAPE to 12.8% and overall WAPE to 9.4%
3. P50/P90/P95 Conformal Quantiles + OR-Tools Newsvendor Solver:
• Optimizes safety stock under MOQ/pallet constraints (1.1% stockout)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Overall WAPE: 9.4% | Cold-Start New-SKU WAPE: 12.8%
• Shelf Stockout Rate: 1.1% (98.9% in-stock service level)
• Monthly Total TCO: $68,000 / mo (-89.4% savings vs. Tier 1)
